events.did: Held the door as Helena stepped into his office with the stone-faced soldier
events.quote_anchor: Gabriel held the door as Helena stepped into his office, followed by the same stone-faced soldier who always trailed her

events.did: Made espresso and set one cup before Helena with one sugar
events.quote_anchor: “Espresso,” he said, carrying the twin cups to the table, and setting one before her. “One sugar, if I’m right.”

events.did: Asked Gabriel what he had learned in the six months since taking over
events.quote_anchor: “All right,” said Helena, taking up the cup and saucer. “You’ve had six months. What have you learned so far?”

events.did: Argued the EOs had to stay at EON to be studied, as patients rather than prisoners
events.quote_anchor: “No,” said Gabriel. “On the contrary. It’s imperative that they stay here. Where they can be studied. Understood.

events.did: Said she would be interested in hearing about a way to guarantee the EOs' cooperation
events.quote_anchor: “So, if there somehow were a way to guarantee cooperation, I’d be interested in hearing…” She trailed off

events.did: Broke out in sweat and stopped breathing normally as the drug took hold
events.quote_anchor: she stopped, as if running out of breath. Sweat broke out along her skin.

events.did: Fell to her hands and knees and then to the floor beside her chair
events.quote_anchor: She fell, first to her hands and knees, and then, to the floor beside her chair.

events.did: Knelt beside Helena, splayed his hand across her skin and watched her chest stop
events.quote_anchor: he admitted as her eyelids fluttered, and her limbs went slack. “But there are better uses of our time.” Her chest rose, and fell, and stopped.

relations.did: Was EON's director, addressed by Gabriel as Director Roy
relations.quote_anchor: Director Roy, there’s no telling what I could learn from these subjects, if given the right tools.

relations.did: Saw Gabriel as an enemy and a captor instead of an ally or confidant
relations.quote_anchor: “It’s hard to build rapport with a cell wall in the way.”

relations.did: Would have obeyed Gabriel's order to shoot Helena Roy in the head
relations.quote_anchor: Of course, if Gabriel told him to shoot Helena Roy in the head, he’d do that, too.

relations.did: Risk their lives to keep the EOs in those cells and would not stand for changing that
relations.quote_anchor: “The guards wouldn’t stand for it. They risk their lives to keep the EOs in those cells.”

numbers.did: Had had six months of work to show Helena Roy
numbers.quote_anchor: “All right,” said Helena, taking up the cup and saucer. “You’ve had six months. What have you learned so far?”
“Espresso,” he said, carrying the twin cups to the table, and setting one before her. “One sugar, if I’m right.”

numbers.did: Held two elegant chairs set across a low table instead of a desk
numbers.quote_anchor: He’d forgone a desk, opting instead to place two elegant chairs across a low table, creating a sense of equity between therapist and patient.
